title: Detection of Sars-Cov2 Using Droplet Digital PCR
author: Joseph Patterson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be8tjhwn
materials: Dispense 11 µL master mix to each PCR tube. •9 parts ddPCR Supermix for Probes (no dUTP) (Bio-Rad 186-3026). •1 part Probe
Obtain a DG8 droplet generator cartridge (Bio-Rad 1864008) and transfer 20 µL of sample to the sample well.
When all droplets for the experiment have been transferred, cover plate with pierceable foil (Bio-Rad 181-4040) with the RED LINE SIDE UP AT THE TOP,
Analysis is performed with the Quantasoft software associated with the droplet reader.
Lower limit of quantitation is 10 copies/ul.
Lower limit of detection is 1 copy/ul.

steps.title: Prepare master mix
steps.instruction: In each PCR tube combine 4.4 µL iScript Reverse Transcription Supermix (Bio‑Rad 1708841) with 6.6 µL DNase/RNase‑free water to make an 11 µL master mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 4.4 µL iScript Reverse Transcription Supermix (Bio‑Rad 1708841)
Mix to a total volume of 11 µL

steps.title: Add RNA sample
steps.instruction: Add 11 µL of the sample or appropriately diluted RNA to each tube (determine optimal dilution beforehand).

steps.title: Seal and mix tubes
steps.instruction: Close each tube and shake by hand to mix the contents.

steps.title: Centrifuge tubes
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tubes to collect liquid at the bottom.

steps.title: Reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a thermocycler with lid temperature set to 105 °C and run: 5 min at 25 °C, 20 min at 46 °C, 1 min at 95 °C, then hold at 4 °C (≈30 min total).

steps.title: Add cDNA to PCR mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 11 µL of the synthesized cDNA into each PCR tube that already contains the master mix.

steps.title: Mix and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Gently mix the tubes and centrifuge briefly to bring the liquid to the bottom.

steps.title: Load droplet oil
steps.instruction: Pipette 70 µL of droplet generation oil (Bio‑Rad 1863005) into the oil well of the droplet generation cartridge.

steps.title: Generate droplets
steps.instruction: Secure the gasket (Bio‑Rad 1863009) onto the cartridge and run the QX Droplet Generator (Bio‑Rad 186‑4002) to create droplets.

steps.title: Transfer droplets to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 40 µL of the generated droplets into each well of a 96‑well plate (Bio‑Rad 12001925).

steps.title: Heat‑seal plate
steps.instruction: Seal the plate using a plate sealer (Bio‑Rad 181‑4000).

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plate in a real‑time thermocycler and run: 10 min at 95 °C; 40 cycles of 30 s at 94 °C then 1 min at 60 °C; 10 min at 98 °C; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Read droplets
steps.instruction: Transfer the plate to the droplet reader and acquire data according to the instrument software.

steps.title: Add positive control cDNA
steps.instruction: Include a 500 copy/µL cDNA standard with the N1 and N2 probes on each plate as a positive control.

steps.title: Add RNaseP probe
steps.instruction: Add a human RNaseP probe to each reaction to confirm that quality RNA was obtained from the sample.

steps.title: Add SARS‑CoV‑2 probes
steps.instruction: Use SARS‑CoV‑2 N1 and N2 probes (and optionally RNaseP) in each reaction; also run a commercial SARS‑CoV‑2 cDNA control with each probe as an additional control.

steps.title: Interpret results
steps.instruction: Classify a sample as a suspected positive when at least 1 copy/µL is detected for both N1 and N2 probes.
